statement: Every Korean price date in 2013-2026 is outcome-exposed. Nothing here can confirm a signal; a favourable result is a hypothesis for prospective receipts, an unfavourable one is reported as it is.

baskets.weighting: equal weight at entry, buy-and-hold to exit
baskets.COMPUTER: not tested separately: Korean computer exports are mostly SSD made by the same two memory makers, so it carries the SEMI information

entry.primary: close of the first session strictly after the publication date
entry.sensitivity: close of the publication date (customs flashes state 09:00 release; MOTIE monthly 09:00-11:00)
entry.announcementReaction: close of the session before publication to close of the publication session (descriptive; not a strategy)

excess: basket simple return minus benchmark simple return over the same entry->exit sessions

priceControls.mom63: basket minus benchmark return over sessions entry-64 .. entry-1
priceControls.mom126: basket minus benchmark return over sessions entry-127 .. entry-1

inference.regression: OLS with Newey-West (Bartlett) standard errors; lags = ceil(H / median spacing between consecutive observations in sessions)
inference.bootstrap: moving-block bootstrap of the ON-minus-OFF mean difference, block = HAC lag + 1 observations, 4000 draws, seed 20261122
inference.primaryCorrection: Holm over the four primary tests, alpha 0.05
inference.secondaryCorrection: Holm over the secondary family, alpha 0.05; descriptive items carry no verdict
inference.minObservations: a test with fewer than 24 observations, or fewer than 8 ON and 8 OFF, is NOT_ESTIMABLE; absence of a result is not evidence against the hypothesis
inference.independentObservations: reported for every test as n * median spacing / H (capped at n)

H1.question: Does the customs 10-/20-day export flash carry information about the semiconductor basket's excess return beyond prior public data and price momentum?
H1.sample: every FLASH10 / FLASH20 release on the KDI archive whose 주요품목 sentence states a semiconductor YoY rate and that has an earlier published semiconductor YoY reading
H1.surprise: flash semiconductor YoY (as published, not working-day adjusted) minus the latest semiconductor YoY published strictly earlier (MOTIE monthly first release of the previous month, or the same month's 10-day flash for a 20-day flash). A public-data expectation proxy, not a market consensus

strategies.rule: KODEX 200 100%; when ON, KODEX 200 70% + 30% equal-weight SEMI basket. 100% equity in both states. State re-decided at each event's entry close and held to the next event; the sleeve drifts between changes; dated costs on executed changes

sensitivities: working-day adjusted surprise where both day counts are stated (total-export day counts applied to the item)

H2.question: Does a turn in the first-release monthly semiconductor export trend predict the semiconductor basket's 6-12 month excess return beyond price momentum?
H2.sample: every MOTIE monthly release (2013-2026, KDI archive, PDF or HWP) from which the semiconductor acceleration is computable as of its publication date
H2.asOfValues: a value month's as-of value is the latest value stated by a release published on or before the decision date; its year-ago base is that value divided by (1 + the YoY rate stated with it), or the year-ago value stated in the same release where the release states one
H2.G3: sum of as-of values of months m, m-1, m-2 over the sum of their year-ago bases, minus 1
H2.accel: G3(m) - G3(m-3), both as of the same decision date

strategies.rule: as H1, decided at each monthly release

H2X-AUTO.expectedSign: + (weak: FX and overseas production drive earnings)

H2X-PETRO.expectedSign: none (export value mostly restates oil prices; margins drive earnings)

H2X-SHIP.expectedSign: 0 (negative control: exports record deliveries of orders booked 2-3 years earlier, after revenue was recognised)

H2.revisionAnalysis: G3 and accel recomputed on the latest stated values; count of sign flips and the dates of the largest semiconductor revisions
H2.earningsLink: descriptive: G3 / accel at each quarter-end month's release vs the Samsung+SK Hynix TTM operating income YoY that became public later (research/investment_decision_alpha_v1/results/kr-semis-case-quarters.csv)
H2.pricedInDiagnostic: R^2 of the monthly change in G3 on the SEMI basket's excess return over the 21 and 63 sessions ending the session before publication; reported, not used as a gate

H3.question: Does the first-release semiconductor shipment-minus-inventory growth (inventory cycle) predict the semiconductor basket's excess return?
H3.sample: every 산업활동동향 release on the KDI archive whose 업종별 생산·출하·재고 table yields the 반도체 row (YoY columns)
H3.signal: ISI = shipment YoY - inventory YoY (first release); ON = 1[ISI > 0]
H3.eligibility: returns are computed only if at least 60 monthly releases are parsed; otherwise NOT_ESTIMABLE and only the data inventory is reported

costs.etf: KODEX 200: commission + half spread, no transaction tax

forbidden: choosing a threshold, window, tilt or horizon after seeing a return
a second run after this one
dropping an industry or a sensitivity from the report
calling the surprise a consensus surprise

knownBeforeOutcomes.H1: 92 flash events 2021-05-21..2026-11-11; about 7 independent observations at 126 sessions (power: DATA-ELIGIBILITY-ko.md section 5)
knownBeforeOutcomes.H2: 119 monthly releases with a computable semiconductor acceleration from 2013-07; AUTO 119, PETRO 119, SHIP 118
knownBeforeOutcomes.H3: 50 parsed IIP months (2021-09..2026-09 plus 2013-03): below the 60-month gate fixed in this protocol before the parse count was known, so H3 is NOT_ESTIMABLE and its secondary slots are dropped from the Holm family rather than filled
knownBeforeOutcomes.revisions: semiconductor first vs latest: median 0.023%, max 1.51%, zero sign flips in G3 or acceleration
